title: Cheesy Orzo Skillet Bake with Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Basil & Eggs

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and orzo, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain and set aside.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
Trim and small dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl with the zucchini and set aside.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel, halve, and small dice onion. Peel and mince garlic.
Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion, garlic, and spices to the skillet. Cook, stirring frequently, until onion begins to soften, 2-3 minutes.
Add zucchini and bell pepper to the skillet. Continue to cook, stirring often, until veggies are tender, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
While the veggies are cooking, coarsely grate cheese. Place in the reserved bowl and set aside.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position the rack in the upper third of the oven.
Add cooked orzo, tomato sauce, and half of the basil to the skillet (reserve remaining basil for serving). Cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce is warmed through, 2-3 minutes. Remove from heat.
Using a stirring spoon, make a well for each egg in the orzo. Crack an egg into each well.
Place skillet in the oven and broil until egg whites are just set, 3-4 minutes. Top with cheese and continue to broil until melted, 1 minute more. Remove from oven.
To serve, divide orzo and eggs between plates or bowls; top with reserved basil. Enjoy!
